requirements: R1: Refactor JwtAuthenticationFilter.doFilterInternal to reduce if/loop nesting to a maximum of 3 levels.
R2: Implement proper error state handling in JwtAuthenticationFilter by catching raw exceptions and throwing AuthenticationExceptions to ensure HTTP 401 is returned for invalid credentials.
R3: Implement actual Moodle integration logic in the codebase to replace empty stubs and fulfill integration requirements.

slices.title: Resolve JwtAuthenticationFilter and Moodle Integration Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing fixes for this epic, I want to refactor the authentication filter and replace Moodle stubs with real logic, so that the self-falsification findings are resolved without inventing adjacent scope.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an incoming request to JwtAuthenticationFilter, When doFilterInternal executes, Then its if/loop nesting level does not exceed 3.
Given a token validation failure that throws a raw exception, When the filter handles it, Then it translates the error to an AuthenticationException and returns HTTP 401, explicitly defining auth/validation behavior.
Given the Moodle integration requirements, When the system authenticates users, Then it executes actual integration logic instead of returning empty stubs, and unit/integration tests assert the correct behavior.
